component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents.listener
component.documentation: The controlled document listener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires it: numbers a first revision on creation; gives a new revision its predecessor's number and the next revision, and marks the predecessor superseded, linked both ways; refuses any other change to the docctl properties, a copy of a controlled document, and a restore that would change them; and, since 0.3.0, keeps each export-control mark: carried to the next revision, changed only by a holder of ChangeExportMark, audited, and a marked revision placed, by a new revision in another folder or a move, only where its mover holds ChangeExportMark. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback.
